messages:
elaine (CS): FYI escalation from Acme: identical queries returning different rerank scores after tonight's model rollout. customer saw top-1 flips and business impact. thread_ts: 1999999999
acme_engineer: we started seeing this right after ~03:21 UTC deploy. sample attached — identical payloads, different scores and ordering. also saw a few 401s and higher latency in that window.
ajim (ML): can you paste the minimal repro here (single query + both responses + headers)?
acme_engineer: pasted below. payload is a standard /v1/rerank request. headers show Authorization present; model header used was `redwood/rerank-latest` (we didn't pin). Response A (earlier): scores [0.92, 0.81, 0.40]. Response B (after): [0.63, 0.61, 0.59]. top-1 flipped.
deploy-bot: deployment finished: model redwood/rerank v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0 at 1999999600 by jim (ML).
ravi (Runtime): looking at infra logs — rollout had a 429 spike and some auth 401s around the same time. Also noticed some traffic was routed to a q8 quantized variant during burst capacity. Could be routing+variant combo.
elaine (CS): customer also reports unexpected billing counts — duplicate rerank calls around rollout time. finance (billing) added to thread.
finance (billing): noted. we will pull billing logs for acme-corp for the 03:00-04:00 UTC window.
jim (ML): unpinned model + rollout can explain different scores. but we need to rule out tokenization or preprocessing changes in the code path. Can you confirm exact model variant reported in the responses?
acme_engineer: responses didn't include model variant header. we only saw timestamps and bodies.
ravi (Runtime): that's on us — response should include `x-redwood-model` header. I'll add to logging. For immediate triage: I can pin Acme's traffic to v3.2.1 to stop score drift.
acme_engineer: please pin. this is blocking search ranking experiments.
ravi (Runtime): created temporary pin for customer acme-corp -> v3.2.1, applied at 1999999800.
deploy-bot: pin applied for acme-corp at 1999999800.
acme_engineer: confirmed pinned and re-tested: scores match the original baseline.
jim (ML): running a quick offline eval on the customer's sample set across v3.2.1 and v3.3.0. preliminary: ~9% top-1 changes, average score delta ~0.6 for impacted queries. That is non-trivial for their distribution.
mateo (SRE): adding repro steps for eng: curl example and payload so we can reproduce.
mateo (SRE): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"query":"How do I reset my password?","candidates":["Reset via settings","Contact support","Use forgot password"]}'```
jim (ML): thanks. I'll check tokenizer output and normalization between the two model artifacts, and run a small A/B scoring job. Also will search recent commits for any preprocessing changes.
ravi (Runtime): two action items from infra: (1) ensure model variant in response headers (added logging PR), (2) introduce sticky-pin during rollouts for active customers above threshold qps. I'll open tickets.
elaine (CS): I'll coordinate with Acme — propose the pin as mitigation and offer a follow-up postmortem once root cause is confirmed. Also ask finance for billing reconciliation.
finance (billing): got the billing logs request; we'll follow up in the ticket.
jim (ML): hypothesis: the model update changed the ranking head calibration and possibly tokenizer normalization. If confirmed, we can either (A) roll v3.3.0 back for this workload, (B) patch v3.3.0 to restore behaviors, or (C) provide customer-facing guidance to pin.
ravi (Runtime): pinned for now. preparing a hotfix and canary plan to align v3.3.0 with previous scoring behavior if needed.
acme_engineer: thanks. we need ETA and confirmation this won't reoccur.
elaine (CS): ETA: pin applied now; hotfix candidate in CI in ~3h, canary rollout after verification in ~6h. I'll schedule a customer call and update ticket.
deploy-bot: hotfix CI started at 2000000100.
acme_engineer: after pinning, scores returned to baseline on our quick pass. appreciate the fast response. will wait for final fix.
elaine (CS): closing loop for now, monitoring. will post postmortem with root cause and billing reconciliation. :thumbsup:
